|rad1oui = |rad1_ant_conn = |rad1txchains = 1 |rad1rxchains = 1 |rad1sstreams = 1 |rad1stand = IEEE 802.11b/g/n |rad1n = 150 |rad1g = 54 |rad1b = 11 |rad1freq = 2.4 }}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== "2976352402" is silkscreened on the board in the FCC photos. Per this [http://forum.netgear.ru/viewtopic.php?id=2705 NETGEAR.ru forum post], A0:21:B7 is an assumed OUI of the device. [[Atheros]] AR7240 device. The WNR612v1 may share the same basic [http://2a.zol-img.com.cn/product/59/462/ce4xIbJrS5HSQ.jpg hardware]. It shares all the hardware with [[Netgear WNR1000v2|WNR1000v2]] and flashing it to WNR1000v2 firmware (over TFTP) works. The only difference is the number of LAN ports. *The bootloader of the device uses a TFTP server. To access the TFTP server the user must hold reset button before the device is powered on and keep on holding it for a few seconds. ==Links of Interest== *[http://support.netgear.com/app/answers/detail/a_id/2649/~/gpl-open-source-code-for-programmers On the Netgear GPL sources page] *[ftp://downloads.netgear.com/files/GPL/ Netgear's GPL sources directory on their FTP server] *[https://openwrt.org/toh/netgear/wnr612v2 ''Netgear WNR612 v2'' on '''OpenWrt''' wiki] *[http://nnm.ru/blogs/aptem82/kompaktnyy_besprovodnoy_router_netgear_wnr612/ Images and screenshots] (RU) ==Flashing== {{Flashnotice}} ===Flashing OpenWrt=== {{OpenWrt |techdata = https://openwrt.org/toh/hwdata/netgear/netgear_wnr612v2 |wikipage = https://openwrt.org/toh/netgear/wnr612v2 |forumpage = https://forum.openwrt.org/t/builds-for-netgear-wnr1000v2-wnr1000v2-vc-wnr612v2-wpn824n-wnr2000v3/39360 |github = |target = ath79 |subtarget = tiny |arch = mips_24kc |support_commit_id = 65584ed54fbcc026b59f437bfd19d8227d7e740a |support_started_version = 14.07 |current_supported_version = EOL |last_supported_version = 19.07.10 |image_too_big = |unsupportedfuncntions = |lan_hardware = Atheros AR7240 |lan_comment = |wlan_hardware = Atheros AR9285 |wlan_comment = |usb_sata_comment = |inst_method = GUI OEM, U-Boot TFTP + serial recovery, see devicepage |inst_comment = |rec_method = U-Boot TFTP + serial recovery |rec_comment = |comment = Official images are too large as of 17.XX.
